div.div: See only real, free time slots

div.button: How do I book an appointment?

div.p: Choose your doctor, pick a date, select one of the free time slots and send your details. Your request reaches the clinic instantly.
No. You can book with just your name, email and phone. A patient portal is optional and can be enabled by the clinic.

div.button: Can I cancel or change my appointment?

div.p: Yes. Once your patient portal access is enabled, you can see your appointments and cancel them there, then book a new time.
Yes. If you gave us your email address, we send a friendly reminder the day before your appointment.

div.button: What if my preferred time is not shown?

div.p: Only free slots are shown. If a time is missing, it is already taken, so please try another date or another doctor.
